capabilities: Generate a table of contents from a note's headings
Insert the TOC after the last H1 or after frontmatter
Auto-refresh an existing TOC when the note changes
Exclude headings by depth or regex pattern
Remove the TOC section and its frontmatter key
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.7.2+. The README notes that duplicate heading names are listed but only the first occurrence is linked, since Obsidian wikilinks cannot address later occurrences.
problem: Obsidian notes have no built-in way to embed a table of contents inside the note body, and existing TOC plugins insert visible comment markers into the source.
summary: Table of contents generator that inserts and maintains a heading-based TOC in notes, tracked by a frontmatter key instead of visible HTML markers.
